comment: h3 v2 on Node 26, served by h3's serve(), which runs srvx's Node adapter, in TypeScript that Node runs without a build step. On lambda-emulator the application's fetch answers behind srvx's AWS Lambda adapter. npm's latest h3 is 2.0.1-rc.32, a release candidate of v2, and the range admits later candidates and the release. One module per family under Implementation/routes registers its routes and gives each route its middleware in the route's options, because h3 runs middleware registered with app.use() on every request. The suite is UnitTests/, node:test over app.request(), and never reaches the image. install-ci-test is npm ci then npm test, because the suite needs node_modules and the typechecker. upgrade is npm update, which moves package-lock.json within the ranges package.json states. There is no Client/, because h3 writes no OpenAPI document.

unsupported.sse.medium: srvx's toLambdaHandler buffers the whole answer, so the events arrive as one body.
unsupported.stream.ndjson: srvx's toLambdaHandler buffers the whole answer, so the rows arrive as one body.
unsupported.baseline.plaintext: srvx's AWS Lambda adapter reads the answer's headers before its body. h3 answers a string with srvx's FastResponse, whose headers gain the text/plain Content-Type only once the body is read, so the answer goes out with none.
unsupported.compressed.gzip_large: srvx's AWS Lambda adapter chooses base64 by the Content-Type alone and ignores Content-Encoding. It writes the gzipped JSON as UTF-8 text, which replaces the bytes that are not UTF-8, so the body arrives corrupt.

noHandler.errors.unmatched: h3's router finds no route for the path, and h3 answers the miss with its 404.
noHandler.errors.wrong_method: The router matches the method and the path together, so a method the path has no route for is a miss, which h3 answers with the same 404.

authorized.mechanism: Middleware in the route's options that compares the bearer token and throws h3's HTTPError with 403 for any other

baseline.builtin: The handler returns the string, which h3 sends as text/plain.

body.mechanism: A zod schema that readValidatedBody runs on the validate routes, reporting every field that fails, and one-field schemas piped one into the next on the first-error route

cache.mechanism: ocache's defineCachedHandler around each cache route's handler, keyed by the path and the headers the route varies on. h3's own cache rule is built on it, and runs on every request

compressed.mechanism: Middleware written for the two routes through h3's onResponse, which gzips a body of 1 KB or more with node:zlib at its fastest level, because h3 ships no compression

cors.mechanism: h3's handleCors, called by the route's handler, which answers a preflight itself and adds its headers to any other request

errors.builtin: h3's router answers a miss with its 404, readBody refuses a body that is not JSON with 400, and the items handlers throw h3's HTTPError with 404, each written as h3's error JSON.

etag.mechanism: h3's handleCacheHeaders, which writes the tag and answers a match with 304, given a SHA-1 of the serialised body that the handler computes, because h3 hashes nothing

forms.builtin: readBody parses a urlencoded body by its content type, and a multipart one when the handler asks for formData. readValidatedBody binds the urlencoded form with query.many's schema.

headers.mechanism: The handler reads the three headers from the request and converts the account, because h3 binds no headers

items.builtin: One route per method on /items/:id, the id converted by a zod schema through getValidatedRouterParams. h3 answers HEAD with the GET route.

json.builtin: The handler returns the payload, which h3 writes with JSON.stringify.

middleware.mechanism: No-op middleware in the route's options, four or sixteen of them

parameters.mechanism: A zod schema that getValidatedRouterParams runs on the captures, converting each to an integer

query.mechanism: A zod schema that getValidatedQuery runs on the query string, converting the numbers to integers

sse.mechanism: h3's EventStream, which the handler returns and which writes each row pushed to it as one event

static.mechanism: h3's serveStatic on a /static/** route, over the payload directory

stream.builtin: The handler returns h3's iterable over a generator of lines, which h3 sends as each is yielded.

template.mechanism: An EJS template compiled once and rendered by the handler, answered through h3's html and raw
